verdict.rationale: Working Copy ships a conversational Repository Agent that can read and modify files, commit, pull and push [working-copy-docs-29], which covers the coding-agent part of the story. The manual also says the app can create something for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab, likely pull requests [working-copy-docs-19]. However, nothing shows assigning an issue to the agent or the agent producing a review-ready pull request on its own, so this is a manual, chat-driven workflow rather than issue-to-PR delegation. Missing for 10: assigning issues to the agent, the agent opening PRs autonomously, an asynchronous/background agent workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
